vibe-security.changes: The description no longer claims every code review, which belongs to the code-review skills. Added a tenth audit step for invented and lookalike dependencies. The rate-limiting example warns that `x-forwarded-for` can be spoofed.

patches.find: description: This skill helps Claude write secure web applications. Use this when working on any web application or when a user requests a scan or audit to ensure security best practices are followed.
patches.replace: description: Secure coding rules for web apps, from a bug hunter's view - access control and IDOR, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, open redirects, file uploads, SQL injection, XXE, path traversal, JWT and GraphQL. Use when writing or reviewing web code that handles user input, logins, permissions, user-supplied URLs, file uploads, XML or database queries, or when the user asks for a security scan of a web app.
